channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 10
item.description:
153 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Tool cupboards now fill evenly across the base, similar to furnaces.

Base Building & Logistics

  • Tool cupboards now fill evenly across the base, similar to furnaces.
  • Conveyor belts now move up to 24 items per tick, speeding up item transport.
  • Cargo container doors can no longer be destroyed; they must be unlocked with melee or explosives. One container is codelocked and requires a large amount of explosives or a code note, with increased explosive damage required and lock UI only visible when looking directly at it.

NPC & AI

  • Scientists now correctly flank targets, fixing previous failures to flank.

Extraction & Raids

  • Extraction maps now include additional monuments, providing more raid destinations.
  • Extracted loot is automatically deposited into a stash, and raiders spawn at the start of a raid.
  • A new 3 km procedural map scene has been added for extraction raids.

World Content

  • Rare shipping containers can spawn on mainland coasts (jungle, arctic, desert) with unique loot; they appear at a rate of one per 100 players.

Deployables & Mobility

  • A fletching jig deployable allows on-site arrow customization.
  • A prototype trampoline deployable adds a new mobility tool for players.

Weapon & Grenade Updates

  • 40 mm incendiary grenade received a new visual effect, sound, icon, and rebalanced damage values.
  • 40 mm flare now uses road flare visuals, appears white, and self-destructs if shot into the ground at close range.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Playing back CCTV footage now safely handles death or dismount, preventing crashes or stuck states.
  • A reload progress bar appears next to the weapon when using the shoulder camera, giving clear reload timing.
  • Arrows with custom skins can now be cleared, reverting them to their original ammo type.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 09
item.description:
184 development commits

Seamless Server Travel

  • Fixed bugs that left players behind boats, caused sleeping, sinking boats, or duplicated/incorrect entities during server transfers.
  • Enabled exiting vehicles and crossing between seamless servers, adding full neighbor connections, server links, vehicle transfers, and client handling for smoother travel.

Base Building & Logistics

  • Rewrote the conveyor system to move a fixed amount of items per tick, speed up when outputs near full, and resume scans after multi‑tick transfers.
  • Fixed a UI bug where powered storage adaptors incorrectly displayed a power requirement message.

World Content

  • Added two Minicopter wrecks per map at monuments that can be repaired for gears, metal fragments, high‑quality metal, and a random tier‑2 modular car part.
  • Implemented BoatDockTrigger on all fishing village docks, preventing vehicles from getting stuck and gently pulling them to the centre of water docks.

Inventory & Combat

  • Fixed AK rifle stacking display so a stack correctly shows 20 AKs instead of an erroneous label.
  • Added a toggle to keep mouse sensitivity consistent across all weapons.
  • Added an ammo indicator to the 40 mm Flashbang grenade.

XCOM Mode Overhaul

  • Introduced a major expansion to the experimental Rust XCOM mode, adding proper weapon handling, new enemy types, ladders, doors, manual furnace, full armoury with loadouts, melee options, overwatch, research, crafting, bases, terrain changes, camera controls, combat animations, cover improvements, loot drops, persistent squads, resource economy, repeatable raids, battle camera, and many other gameplay systems.

Tools & Building

  • Fixed a crash caused by a NullReferenceException in the Wire Tool preview, preventing crashes and missing wire previews.

Loot & Exploration

  • Cargo ship interior loot is now secured inside seven shipping containers; players must break them open (explosives/melee) to access loot, with one empty and one unlocked container containing brown crates.
